macros.name: ulqdaClearSectFilter
macros.doc: \ulqdaClearSectFilter clears a section filter establihed by \ulqdaSetSectFilter so that a subsequent \ulqdaGraph or a \ulqdaTable macro will process all sections from the CSV file.

macros.name: ulqdaCloud
macros.doc: \ulqdaCloud is a macro which invokes processing of the generated CSV file to create a LaTeX cloud (see table 2).

macros.name: ulqdaCode
macros.doc: \ulqdaCode is used to assign a code a particular sentence or passage of text.

macros.name: ulqdaGraph
macros.doc: \ulqdaGraph is a macro which invokes processing of the generated CSV file to allow the visualisation of a coded ontology as a GraphViz diagram.

macros.name: ulqdaHighlight
macros.doc: \ulqdaHighlight is used to format coded text for typesetting purposes.

macros.name: ulqdaSetSectFilter
macros.doc: \ulqdaSetSectFilter establishes a filter for the next \ulqdaGraph or \ulqdaTable macro.
